title: EviGraph FinQA 300 Oracle-doc and Source-rerank GPT-5.4 Direct RAG Baselines
limitations: This manifest completes the GPT-5.4 Direct RAG three-setting comparison by running oracle-doc and source-rerank only; Open BM25 is already run in configs/experiments.finqa_300.open_bm25.gpt54_direct_rag.json.
The model is fixed in the config as gpt-5.4; the OpenAI-compatible base URL and API key must be provided through LLM_BASE_URL and LLM_API_KEY.
Oracle-doc constrains retrieval to the gold source_doc and source-rerank softly promotes the known source_doc, so both are analysis settings rather than deployable open-retrieval claims.
The baseline uses retrieval-order evidence and does not use the EviGraph operation planner, risk-aware support selection, or verifier-guided repair.
The verifier still scores the output after generation so exact match and support diagnostics are comparable to local baselines.
